statistics.locator: Results, final paragraph on trail-making test
statistics.quote: In the trail-making test, the completion time for young subjects was 27.4±7.2 s and that for old subjects was 42.5±6.9 s; the difference was statistically significant (t(22)=5.25; P<0.001).
statistics.effect_as_written: difference between young and old subjects in trail-making test completion time
statistics.model_fitted_to: each subject's time to completion of the trail-making test (single administration)
statistics.direction_quote: the completion time for young subjects was 27.4±7.2 s and that for old subjects was 42.5±6.9 s
statistics.admissible_reason: Independent two-group t test of exactly old vs young experimental subjects on the single-administration screening (trail-making) completion time; t value and df printed.
statistics.notes: The paper calls this the 'trail-making test' (connect numbers 1 to 25 in ascending order, time to completion recorded), matching the outcome definition. Group means with SDs are printed alongside the t test.

statistics.admissible_reason: No standardised effect size is printed for the screening-test comparison.
